raw_comment:
I noticed that everywhere in New York has a drought. Everywhere in the U.S is experiencing some sort of water shortage. The middle of the country is experiencing the most droughts. The coasts have less intense droughts. 
I wonder if the high levels of drought will continue to raise. I also wonder how we can prevent this. Does climate change have a role in these drought levels? 
This relates to me and my community because I am in the United States. Climate changes and high weather have been causing a lot of environmental issues an d the government has not been doing much about it.
catchy headline- Droughts are growing in the U.S!
